name: officetopdf
description: Command-line utility for converting Microsoft Office documents to PDF format

officetopdf.description: Convert Word, Excel, PowerPoint documents to PDF using Microsoft Office automation
officetopdf.usage:
OfficeToPDF.exe document.docx output.pdf
OfficeToPDF.exe spreadsheet.xlsx report.pdf
OfficeToPDF.exe presentation.pptx slides.pdf
OfficeToPDF.exe /bookmarks document.docx bookmarked.pdf
